proposal: C1 candidate — Home Under Threat While Leading
status: PROPOSED — discovery evidence only. NOT confirmed. O1 remains locked.
why_this_is_a_proposal_not_a_finding: The 630-episode run scanned many combinations of failure indicators, actionable contexts and precursor features. Its confidence intervals describe the candidates it surfaced; they do not confirm them. Confirmation requires a separate run on fresh held-out seeds testing ONLY the frozen definition below.

C1_DEFINITION.name: home_under_threat_while_leading
C1_DEFINITION.opportunity_matched_population: windows in which BLUE was leading (opp_leading) — controls are leads that were KEPT, so the contrast is 'why do some leads survive and others do not', not 'what happens when you are behind'
precursor_state_all_legally_observable: our flag is away from home / the enemy is carrying it
home is threatened (nearest red to our flag closer than nearest blue)
an enemy defender has its tag available
carrier pressure is increasing (closing distance over the window)
C1_DEFINITION.decision_fork: recover our flag vs continue pressure / race home
C1_DEFINITION.alternative_response_a_specialist_could_: immediate defensive rotation to intercept the enemy carrier instead of continuing to attack
C1_DEFINITION.precursor_window: 30 decisions, ending strictly BEFORE the failing decision

EVIDENCE.prevalence: 62-64 failure episodes out of 210 per seed (~30%)

RANKED_AGAINST_THE_DECLARED_HIERARCHY.2_ci_backed_under_episode_clustering: YES — all three seeds, intervals tight and excluding zero
RANKED_AGAINST_THE_DECLARED_HIERARCHY.3_enough_distinct_episodes_not_merely_wi: YES — 62-64 failure episodes and 82-103 control episodes per seed
RANKED_AGAINST_THE_DECLARED_HIERARCHY.4_observable_before_the_failure: YES — window ends exclusive of the failing decision; enforced by tests/test_g0_v2_precursor_integrity.py
RANKED_AGAINST_THE_DECLARED_HIERARCHY.5_describes_a_changeable_decision: YES — rotate home to intercept vs keep attacking
RANKED_AGAINST_THE_DECLARED_HIERARCHY.6_recreatable_from_valid_states: YES — construct: BLUE ahead on score, RED carrying the blue flag, both BLUE agents past the midline, RED defender off cooldown
RANKED_AGAINST_THE_DECLARED_HIERARCHY.7_clear_anchor_context: YES — ordinary attacking play with home secure, where G0 should remain preferable

HONEST_CAVEATS: The top three features are near-collinear: 'our flag away from home', 'enemy carrying', and 'home threatened' are largely the same underlying fact. They should be treated as ONE signal, not three independent confirmations.

That signal is also partly mechanical — the enemy must hold our flag to score it. What makes the contrast non-tautological is the opportunity matching: controls are windows where BLUE was ALSO leading and did NOT lose the lead. The question is why some leads survive.
The genuinely independent contributions are defender_tag_available_frac (+0.438) and carrier_pressure_increasing (+0.380), which are not implied by the enemy holding the flag.
This is a discovery analysis over many combinations. No multiplicity correction was applied, by design.

RUNNER_UP_NOT_PROPOSED.name: carrier_mostly_unescorted
RUNNER_UP_NOT_PROPOSED.why_attractive: an ACTIONABLE context rather than a failure label; recurring in 3/3 seeds with a mean win-rate drop of 0.256 and healthy prevalence (0.34-0.44); maps cleanly onto an Artifact-Assault-style escort specialist
RUNNER_UP_NOT_PROPOSED.why_not_chosen: it is a layer-2 episode descriptor with no episode-clustered confidence interval. The declared hierarchy places CI-backing at position 2, and home_under_threat_while_leading satisfies it while this does not.
RUNNER_UP_NOT_PROPOSED.recommendation: keep as the second C1 candidate if the confirmation run rejects the first

FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.status: declared now, before any confirmation data exists
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.opportunity_matched_population: windows where BLUE is leading on score
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.single_feature_only: one feature, chosen in advance, to avoid selecting the most attractive of many
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.expected_effect_direction: POSITIVE — home_threatened_frac must be HIGHER before a lost lead than in matched controls. A negative result, however large, is a rejection, not a finding.
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.minimum_support: at least 30 failure episodes and 30 control episodes per seed
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.pass_criterion: delta >= 0.15 AND 95% CI excludes zero, in at least 2 of 3 fresh seeds
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.evaluation_seeds: fresh, disjoint from 9400000+ (discovery), 9300000-2 (panel), 9200000+ (diagnostic), 9100000+ (V6I9 discovery), and all training seeds
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.policies: the same three frozen G0-V5 1M checkpoints — no retraining
FROZEN_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.nothing_left_to_choose: population, window, feature, direction, support, threshold and statistic are all fixed above
